item.title: Juiced.GS ends annual Apple II convention - Juiced.GS
item.description: Juiced.GS has ended the run of JuicedFest, the longest-running conference dedicated to the longest-running print publication dedicated to the Apple II.

item.title: Enjoy Juiced.GS Volume 30, Issue 2 (June 2025) - Juiced.GS
item.description: The September 2025 issue of Apple II magazine has shipped, with looks at Shufflepuck Cafe, Nox Worldbuilder, A2Pico, and more!

item.title: Juiced.GS continues in 2026 - Juiced.GS
item.description: Juiced.GS will continue publication into 2026 with its 31st volume. To celebrate, we're having a 15% sale, with donations to Ryan Suenaga's memorial scholarship.
